faq.a: We are located at 123 Main Street, Springfield. Free parking is available in the church lot, and someone at the door will be glad to point you the right way.
Sunday worship begins at 10:00 AM. We also gather for Bible study on Wednesdays at 7:00 PM.

faq.q: Is there something for my kids?
faq.a: Yes! Children are welcome in every service, and our Children's Ministry offers safe, engaging, age-appropriate activities on Sunday mornings.
